notes: Lists of 0..6 entries (80% unit kind) in 1..8 groups. Stubs: 0xbc5d0 returns the group count (random upper half), 0xcc6c0 returns the table (random old contents; 0xb3fb0 runs as original), 0xcc1ac / 0xf83d0 / 0xcbfa0 return queued flags (0, 1, 0x10000, 0xffff), distances (some negative or zero) and ranges (random upper half), 0xcc768 logs the freed table.
